title: maintainer: run one fresh order_to_cash scratch build on main, so its verified build can be committed as a fixture (#34920)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYo86w1wqy2z2fMrryr

Maintainer-action: run one fresh `order_to_cash` scratch build of the scenario runner on current `main` (Claude Code subscription login, authoring model `opus` at effort `high`, as `travel_expense`'s fixture was built) and post the run's `dist/objectstack.json` from before its iterate turn, with its Build and Seed scores, on #34920 — done when #34920 carries that file (or a link to it) whose sha256 re-scores Build all-pass and Seed all-pass against the card.

## Why this is the maintainer's

#34920's remaining item is `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/order_to_cash.json`: byte for byte the `dist/objectstack.json` a PASSING scratch run built (`docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` § Verified builds). Producing it is a live model run — the runner drives `claude -p` to author the app. Live eval runs are the maintainer's (triage 7153950653; seat routing). Everything after the file exists is a seat's: commit it with its `.provenance.json` (sha256, card sha256, runner sha, packages, author model/effort), plus #34920's L2 notes N1–N7 (6986428648).

## What changed since the last attempt

The 2026-11-18 attempt (#34920 dev report 6985513722) failed two ways:
- Seed 553/619: the build's own open-balance rule refused 66 `demoorder_payment` rows — the #34986 shape. #34986 is closed and PR #37156 (merged 2026-11-25 03:39Z) makes `os validate` / `os build` refuse such seed rows before load, so the authoring turn now sees the refusal and fixes it.
- Build 169/170: `security-rollup-source-unreadable` on `demoorder_invoice.amount_paid` for `demoorder_sales_rep`. No card owns this one (L2 note N3). If it recurs, the run is not a verified build; post the reading on #34920 and the seat files that trap as its own card.

## How (from the README; the runner's own docs are canonical)

- A scratch run of `docs/qa/scenarios/order_to_cash.json` with `--packages workspace` built at the run's `origin/main` sha (the maintainer's 2026-11-24 order that testing does not wait for releases), authoring `opus` / `high`.
- Keep the `dist/objectstack.json` written after the Build half, before the iterate turn; note the runner sha, the card sha256 and the served model.

Blocks: #34920
